cohort: 382 women in the postpartum period (6-8 weeks, 10-12 weeks, 14-16 weeks, >9 months, >15 months) who underwent either elective/emergency cesarean section or normal vaginal delivery and had delivered a single live child in Pakistan.
finding: Women who had a vaginal delivery had significantly higher postpartum HRQOL scores compared to women who had a cesarean section.
mod_finding: Women who had a vaginal delivery had significantly higher postpartum HRQOL scores compared to women who had a cesarean section.
